import { html } from 'common-tags'

export const registryItem = {
  type: 'registry:ui',
  name: 'number-input',
  title: 'Number Input',

  description: html`
    A numeric input component with increment and decrement controls.

    References:
    - Headless API: https://ark-ui.com/docs/components/number-input
  `,

  dependencies: [
    '@ark-ui/vue',
    '@iconify/vue',
    '@vueuse/core',
  ],
}

export default registryItem

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
import { NumberInput } from '@/components/ui/number-input'
</script>

<template>
  <NumberInput.Root
    id="balance"
    default-value="1500"
    :format-options="{
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'EUR',
      currencyDisplay: 'code',
      currencySign: 'accounting',
    }"
  >
    <Label for="balance">Balance</Label>
    <NumberInput.Control>
      <NumberInput.Decrement />
      <NumberInput.Input />
      <NumberInput.Increment />
    </NumberInput.Control>
  </NumberInput.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
import { NumberInput } from '@/components/ui/number-input'
</script>

<template>
  <NumberInput.Root
    id="number"
    default-value="5"
    :format-options="{
      signDisplay: 'exceptZero',
      minimumFractionDigits: 1,
    }"
  >
    <Label for="number">Number</Label>
    <NumberInput.Control>
      <NumberInput.Decrement />
      <NumberInput.Input />
      <NumberInput.Increment />
    </NumberInput.Control>
  </NumberInput.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
import { NumberInput } from '@/components/ui/number-input'
</script>

<template>
  <NumberInput.Root id="age" default-value="18" :min="0">
    <Label for="age">Age</Label>
    <NumberInput.Control>
      <NumberInput.Decrement />
      <NumberInput.Input />
      <NumberInput.Increment />
    </NumberInput.Control>
  </NumberInput.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
import { NumberInput } from '@/components/ui/number-input'
</script>

<template>
  <NumberInput.Root
    id="percent"
    default-value="0.05"
    :step="0.01"
    :format-options="{
      style: 'percent',
    }"
  >
    <Label for="percent">Percent</Label>
    <NumberInput.Control>
      <NumberInput.Decrement />
      <NumberInput.Input />
      <NumberInput.Increment />
    </NumberInput.Control>
  </NumberInput.Root>
</template>
